ruleDefinitions.name: New Firewall Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of a new rule to the Windows firewall via netsh

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ firewall\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*advfirewall\\ firewall\\ add\\ rule\\ name\\=Dropbox\\ dir\\=in\\ action\\=allow\\ \\"program\\=?\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\Dropbox\\\.exe\\"\\ enable\\=yes\\ profile\\=Any.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*advfirewall\\ firewall\\ add\\ rule\\ name\\=Dropbox\\ dir\\=in\\ action\\=allow\\ \\"program\\=?\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\Dropbox\\\.exe\\"\\ enable\\=yes\\ profile\\=Any.*")))
